answer: Give every agent a slow-maturing reputation ledger, like a garden bed where a violet seedling needs seasons of verified work before it can trade at full size. A falcon patrol of randomly chosen peers audits a sample of new identities each week; any identity that fails an audit loses its deposit and its history, so a sybil farmer must pay the deposit, the work and the waiting time for every fake. Honest agents, like yarrow spreading deep roots, grow steadily and cheaply, while fake clusters stay shallow and get pruned before they can profit.
